name: 🍔 Buffalo Chicken Sliders
what: Shredded buffalo chicken and cheese on a tray of soft rolls, baked together.

core.name: Frank's RedHot
core.out: BBQ sauce for a mild tray

extras: butter, garlic powder, ranch or blue cheese, celery

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 375°F. Simmer the chicken in salted water.
Shred the chicken with two forks. Toss with Frank's mixed with melted butter. Keep some plain for anyone who wants mild.
Slice the whole sheet of rolls in half sideways. Bottoms in a 9×13 dish, then chicken, cheese and the tops.
Brush the tops with garlic butter. Bake covered 10, uncovered 5.
Pull apart. Serve with ranch and celery.

key: Mix the hot sauce with butter so it sticks to the chicken instead of soaking the bun.
done: Cheese is melted and the tops are golden.
plan_b: No rolls? Buffalo chicken wraps or over rice.
